Role: Psychoanalyst and Psychotherapist
Industry: Mental Health Care
Company size: 501-1,000 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Asana offers us with great project management features which enable us to plan and streamline our projects operations making it possible to achieve our objectives. Asana has robust project visual boards and tracking features which help us to track the progress of each task during projects. Asana has collaboration features which help us to communicate efficiently and work together during projects. Asana offers incredible project reporting features which help us to gain clear insights about how well or poor we are performing when working on our projects.

Role: Naturopathic doctor
Industry: Alternative Medicine
Company size: Self-employed
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 3
Pros: I liked the ease of use and how easily it allowed me to work with team members. It helped me track all tasks and see progress of other members, and also allow communication between members
Cons: At times I felt it was cumbersome to utilize and I wished it had a simpler UX because it was almost too many options for the interface

Role: Performance Excellence Manager
Industry: Consumer Services
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: A really intuitive platform that makes planning everything from daily tasks to larger projects simple.
Cons: No real issues for me as I specifically chose Asana over other similar options as I found all of the features easy to use and logical.
Comments: Excellent, I use Asana successfully to manage the daily tasks of myself and my team to maximise productivity, alongside having also used to successfully deliver larger projects.
Reasons for choosing: For me Asana best met my requirements in terms of being the most intuitive platform for my needs.
Alternatives considered: monday.com AI Work Platform

Role: Marketing Assistant
Industry: Education Management
Company size: 1,001-5,000 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: This has been the most powerful project management tool. It has bee so easy to use and manage. They also have affordable prices.
Cons: It has been more than three years of working with Asana and we have never seen anything bad about it.

Role: Owner and Designer
Industry: Construction
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: The ability for staff member to communicate internally and view their tasks on one platform, and track progress.
Cons: The platform can be a bit overwhelming to navigate at times, due to the multiple of features and tabs.
Comments: Overall I was impressed with Asana's capabilities and the variety of options, plus the various customizations it provided.

Role: Lead UI Developer
Industry: Computer Software
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: The Agentic AI has been very helpful in organizing one's time during a work week. It helps me to not get over-scheduled and overwhelmed and is a true helping hand in task scheduling management.
Cons: I have been using Asana for a long time now. There is nothing I do not like about it. I have no difficulty navigating the UI and functionalities.
Comments: Happy and more relaxed in my workweek thanks to the Agentic AI feature. I notice new employees are managing to navigate the kaban boards easily and with minimal learning effort.

Role: Administrative Assistant
Industry: Non-Profit Organization Management
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Asana brings it all together! Streamlining has never been easier!
Cons: Asana is a good program! There is nothing I really did not like.
Comments: Asana will streamline and help organize your workflow.

Role: Assay development and integration technician
Industry: Biotechnology
Company size: 201-500 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: Asana is its intuitive interface and has the strong task management capabilities. It makes it easy to create, assign, and track tasks with clear deadlines and priorities. Features like project timelines, boards, and lists provide flexibility in managing different types of workflows. It also improves team collaboration by keeping all updates, comments, and files in one place.
Cons: One drawback is that some advanced features, such as timelines and reporting, are limited to higher-tier plan
Comments: Asana has been very positive. It has significantly improved project visibility, accountability, and team coordination. The platform helps streamline workflows and ensures that tasks are completed on time.

Role: Manager
Industry: Sports
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Asana is great because you can have many users on there with specific tasks and is very easy for management to hold them accountable along with holding themselves accountable.
Cons: There are a lot of email notifications that get sent that are not necessary. The program itself I don’t have any cons with.
Comments: Asana is super helpful and useful in a small or big group setting! It makes it easy to distribute daily, weekly and monthly tasks/ reminders.

Role: Head of SEO
Industry: Internet
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 3
Ease-of-use rating: 3
Pros: Good for launching and organizing tasks in teams and communicating with team members and outside contributors
Cons: Threads can become so huge that we lose track of what is being said and the notification system is mediocre
Comments: I give Asana 3 out 5. I think this app isn't the place to discuss at length tasks. The best experience was for for short tasks where details had been worked out.
